name: finding_add
description: Record or update a structured security finding in the shared assessment ledger: severity, asset, description, evidence, status, tags. Idempotent for the same title and asset.

asset.description: Host, URL, file or service the finding applies to.

description.description: What was observed and why it matters.

evidence.description: Commands, responses, hashes or other evidence.

source.description: Tool or workflow that produced the finding.
